# README Rules

- `README.md` is the shared GitHub landing page and package-index long description.
- Keep it concise: positioning, install path, one quick-start example, core capabilities, and links outward.
- Prefer absolute URLs so package-index rendering stays correct.
- Avoid deep API detail, contributor workflow detail, long benchmark discussion, and implementation-history narration.
- If wording, scope, or ownership changes, consult `.design/reference/public_surfaces_plan.md`.
- If the task coordinates README with docs pages or the paper, use the `public-surface-sync` skill.
